description:
The Fremen sietch scenario is the recommended way to meet the mod on its own terms. It starts the colony with enough local knowledge to function, but not enough comfort to ignore Arrakis.

That balance matters. The opening is meant to feel competent but pressured: you have the tools to survive, and now you must prove you can use them before the desert takes them back.
name: Fremen sietch

campaignRhythm.body: Early play should alternate between consolidation and exposure. Build just enough to endure, then step back into the desert for resources that might let the colony last.

openingDays.body: Choose a builder able to construct the early powered cooking route (Construction 4), plus survivors able to grow, cook, craft/tailor and haul; several roles can share one pawn. Assign the capable builder to construction and leave inexperienced helpers hauling or producing rather than risking scarce materials. Install the carried personal condenser and enclose/roof food storage before large garden walls: a roof without walls does not stop desert mice. Build windtraps, reclaimed edible/fiber beds, passive water-fed cooling, sun cells, conduits, a battery, powered cooking and hand tailoring. The opening now provides 1,150 finite steel, 20 industrial components, 60 cloth, 80 water rations, 60 survival meals and 60 chemfuel; wearables, medicine, spice and the carried condenser are separate parts of the scenario. The steel reserve includes construction-loss/repair margin; it is not renewable production. Preserve cloth for cooler pads. Chemfuel bridges emergencies while the solar grid and crops come online; crop-fed refining is later progression, not day-one rescue. A new-game letter explains this order without changing native skills or spawning additional goods.

premise.body: This scenario is not a generic crashlanding transplanted onto a desert tileset. It is a survival start built around the systems the mod wants to foreground: water discipline, carried reserves, stillsuits, spice temptation, and maker threat.

summary: The intended first campaign for the mod: three desert survivors, limited reserves, practiced sandwalking, and a world where water and wormsign matter from the opening hours.
